components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:12px 24px; border-radius:999px; background:#0F6E56; color:#FFFFFF; box-shadow:inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.3),0 10px 26px rgba(15,110,86,.18); font:600 15px/1 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color .18s,transform .12s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#0B1810; transform:scale(1.025); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #67A92E; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(.97); }

components.name: Glass Navigation
components.description: A translucent launch rail that keeps the official mark crisp while content moves beneath it.
components.html: with not forAboutServicesGet in Touch
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:28px; min-height:52px; padding:0 20px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.46); border-radius:16px; background:rgba(250,249,248,.70); box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(11,24,16,.07),inset 0 -1px rgba(255,255,255,.75); color:#0B1810; backdrop-filter:saturate(185%) blur(20px); font:500 14px/1.2 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,sans-serif; } .ds-nav strong { margin-right:auto; color:#0F6E56; } .ds-nav a { padding:11px 18px; border-radius:999px; background:#0B1810; color:#fff; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #67A92E; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Briefing Tab
components.description: A compact native tab for the workflow example.
components.css: .ds-tab { min-height:44px; padding:8px 16px; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:#F5F8F6; color:#0F6E56; font:700 14px/1.2 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,sans-serif; transition:background-color .2s,transform .2s; } .ds-tab:hover { background:#E8EFEA; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #67A92E; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Capability Lens
components.description: A liquid-glass product readout for one WNF capability.
components.html: SystemsAI that fits the work.
components.css: .ds-lens { width:220px; padding:16px 18px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.72); border-radius:28px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.64); box-shadow:0 24px 72px rgba(11,24,16,.14),inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.92); color:#0B1810; backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(145%); font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,sans-serif; } .ds-lens svg { width:24px; height:24px; fill:none; stroke:#0F6E56; stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-lens strong,.ds-lens span { display:block; } .ds-lens strong { margin-top:10px; font-size:15px; } .ds-lens span { margin-top:3px; color:#5A6B61; font-size:12px; }

components.name: Highlight Panel
components.description: A product chapter whose readable copy appears only while the panel is centered.
components.html:
Get real adoption.

Technology does not change behavior on its own.
components.css: .ds-highlight { width:520px; min-height:340px; padding:48px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.72); border-radius:28px; background:#F5F8F6; color:#0B1810; box-shadow:0 24px 72px rgba(11,24,16,.14); font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,sans-serif; } .ds-highlight h3 { margin:0; max-width:10ch; font-size:48px; line-height:.98; letter-spacing:-.04em; text-wrap:balance; } .ds-highlight p { max-width:34ch; margin:24px 0 0; font-size:18px; line-height:1.5; }

components.name: Human-led Badge
components.description: A dark-field glass status label that keeps human control explicit.
components.html: Human-led
components.css: .ds-human-led { display:inline-flex; min-height:42px; align-items:center; gap:9px; padding:10px 16px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18); border-radius:999px; background:rgba(21,29,24,.58); box-shadow:0 32px 96px rgba(0,0,0,.24),inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.18); color:#fff; backdrop-filter:blur(18px); font:600 12px/1.2 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,sans-serif; } .ds-human-led svg { width:18px; height:18px; fill:none; stroke:#9FE870; stroke-width:1.8; stroke-linecap:round; }

components.name: Brand Reactor
components.description: An orbital liquid-glass circuit core used where another robot would dilute the character.
components.css: .ds-reactor { position:relative; display:grid; width:180px; aspect-ratio:1; place-items:center; border:1px solid rgba(15,110,86,.24); border-radius:50%; background:radial-gradient(circle at 38% 32%,rgba(255,255,255,.92),rgba(255,255,255,.38) 26%,transparent 27%),rgba(15,110,86,.10); box-shadow:inset 0 0 44px rgba(15,110,86,.14),0 28px 72px rgba(11,24,16,.16); color:#0F6E56; } .ds-reactor i { position:absolute; inset:10%; border:1px solid rgba(15,110,86,.4); border-radius:50%; animation:ds-orbit 8s linear infinite; } .ds-reactor i:nth-child(2) { inset:24%; animation-duration:5.5s; animation-direction:reverse; } .ds-reactor i::after { position:absolute; top:-4px; left:48%; width:8px; aspect-ratio:1; border-radius:50%; background:#0F6E56; box-shadow:0 0 16px #0F6E56; content:""; } .ds-reactor svg { z-index:2; width:42%; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } @keyframes ds-orbit { to { transform:rotate(360deg); } }

components.name: Signal Replay
components.description: A live signal meter that replays the footer robot-to-logo transformation.
components.css: .ds-signal { display:flex; height:24px; align-items:end; gap:5px; padding:11px 12px; border:1px solid rgba(159,232,112,.3); border-radius:999px; background:rgba(17,20,18,.72); box-shadow:0 12px 38px rgba(0,0,0,.24),inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.12); cursor:pointer; backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(150%); } .ds-signal span { width:3px; height:35%; border-radius:999px; background:#9FE870; animation:ds-pulse 1.25s ease-in-out infinite alternate; } .ds-signal span:nth-child(2) { height:70%; animation-delay:-.3s; } .ds-signal span:nth-child(3) { height:100%; animation-delay:-.6s; } .ds-signal span:nth-child(4) { height:62%; animation-delay:-.45s; } .ds-signal span:nth-child(5) { height:42%; animation-delay:-.15s; } .ds-signal:hover { border-color:rgba(159,232,112,.7); transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-signal:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #9FE870; outline-offset:4px; } @keyframes ds-pulse { to { transform:scaleY(.45); opacity:.45; } }

narrative.overview:
This system translates the current Apple Mac mini launch page's stillness, scale changes, and product-reveal choreography into With Not For's human-controlled AI worldview. `WNF.AI` arrives as the dominant object, moves through five authored material states, compresses into the exact orange robot, and resolves above a human palm before the source positioning line takes over. The page feels like a product launch because the implementation itself is the proof of craft.

After the 7.8-second opening, the page moves through single-idea viewports, a horizontal highlights sequence, a dedicated robot product-theatre chapter, sticky service chapters, a realistic Morning Briefing interaction, and an exact-logo particle finale. It remains unmistakably With Not For through its official logo, deep forest palette, practical source copy, and refusal to invent proof.
keyCharacteristics: One rehearsed five-state opening animation, supported by purposeful scroll choreography rather than repeated fade-and-rise effects.
Very large type, deliberate whitespace, and one dominant thought per fold.
Forest, paper, and black fields punctuated by the orange robot.
The opening palm plus editorial people photography make “with, not for” visibly human; the later human-led chapter contains no floating hand.
Exactly three authored robot appearances: opening collaborator, product-theatre breakdown, and footer transformation seed.
Brand-specific circuit, systems, team, policy, and adoption icons drawn from one stroke grammar, then animated with distinct motion signatures.
Liquid glass reserved for interactive controls, capability lenses, and literal interface surfaces.
The footer robot dissolves through six circuit routes into deterministic alpha-sampled particles, then locks to the exact official WNF logo.
Full keyboard, touch, reduced-motion, and narrow-screen states.

rules.name: The Orange Is an Object Rule
rules.body: Robot orange belongs to the robot and its direct system pulse. It is not sprayed across buttons, headings, or decorative gradients.

rules.name: The Scale Carries the Drama Rule
rules.body: Large type, space, and weight create the hierarchy. Gradient text, ornamental serif pairings, and repeated uppercase eyebrow labels are prohibited.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Physical Rule
rules.body: A shadow is allowed only when an object is meant to feel physically above the page or responding to interaction.

dos: Do preserve the five approved wordmark transformations, product bridge, and measured 7.8-second pacing.
Do use the official logo, exact current homepage copy, and traceable routes.
Do keep the human visibly in control of the AI collaborator.
Do keep the robot to exactly three placements: opening, product theatre, and footer transformation.
Do use single-idea viewports and generous whitespace instead of shrinking everything into a dashboard.
Do keep every active text block fully inside the viewport at 320px through wide desktop sizes.
Do use liquid glass only for interactive or informational lenses and keep clickable motion on an inner visual layer.
Do load the complete final hero immediately for reduced-motion users.
donts: Don't make this look like a generic AI SaaS template, a neon cyberpunk robot page, or a card-filled agency theme.
Don't copy Apple trademarks, Apple product media, Apple copy, Apple pricing, or Apple navigation branding.
Don't use gradient text outside the single robot-material opening state, generic purple-blue gradients, emoji icons, fake dashboards, or invented metrics.
Don't invent clients, results, testimonials, guarantees, or product capabilities.
Don't use a colored side stripe, nest cards, or hide essential meaning behind hover or animation.
Don't repeat the robot as a decorative icon; use the branded circuit reactors for policy, systems, and human-led states.
